observation: Initialized Themis GRC project repository as greenfield portfolio demonstration.
Successfully integrated 11 requested agent skills across all 79 supported harnesses via skills CLI into .agents/skills/.
Established Clean Architecture and S.O.L.I.D. foundation (ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003) separating pure domain rules from UI/Infrastructure.
Created multi-AI compatibility symlinks for .gemini, .cursor, .opencode, and .codex pointing to .agents/ single source of truth.
Scaffolded Clean Architecture project with React 19, Vite, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, and verified with passing TDD Vitest tests.

Audited 51 .agents/skills: all four agents (Antigravity, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor) natively scan .agents/skills. Adapter symlink dirs from ADR-0001 (.claude/.codex/.opencode/.gemini) are absent and not required for skill discovery. Catalog omits 17 installed skills. find-similar-functions is referenced but not installed.
Added GEMINI.md, amended ADR-0001 for native skill discovery, synced skills catalog to 52 skills, installed find-similar-functions.

Accepted rules-hardening spec with feature-based iris layout, Nest module template, Query-only interactions, hook isolation, 150-line cap, and feature-local test colocation. Cascaded into rules 00-06, ADR-0002 through 0005, AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, bridges, and memory.

Accepted ADR-0006 (operational process-risk, PostgreSQL+Prisma, heatmap cell poco frecuente x bajo = Insignificante, familyId migration) and ADR-0007 (CompanyMembership + ProcessAssignment; not Oso). Workflow diagram in .agents/knowledge/operational-process-workflow.md. Spec Prisma dump is illustrative.
Recorded ADR-0006 and ADR-0007; cascaded workflow diagram and auth/data decisions into DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, rules 05/06, knowledge, spec, memory, and task board.
